m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Jordan Post routing-assignment release complete for its declared source, jurisdiction and time scope preserves five-digit strings and typed locality, post-office, route and P.O. Box objects, with reproducible full-data conversion and validation, immutable published data and actual AGID loader/API verification. Postal offices, dated UPU syntax, incomplete physical-addressing policy, villages, streets, MoUs and digital-mailbox pilots cannot substitute for assignments, official postal polygons or explicit civic-address/building relations. Geometry, derived surfaces, civic/building links, privacy, validity and reuse rights remain independently evidenced.

quality_rules: Profile the complete downloaded dated office file, not incomplete datastore pages. File retrieval time, metadata modification, catalog year and record validity differ.
Two resource IDs can resolve to identical bytes. Count unique artifact digests; do not double national coverage. A repeated postcode is not necessarily a duplicate office.
The candidate office key is governorate/name/code, not a stable official assignment ID. Never infer missing governorates by forward fill or derive postal areas from office rows.
Discard office addresses, property status, notes and hours from output. No source rows, names, recipients, customers, owners, cadastral records or coordinates enter Git.
Measured office-file quality is not current assignment quality. Production-assignment rates stay null until a current permitted assignment input is obtained.
